name: Mortis (Path of the Four Humours) — 2 Intermediate — Clutching the Shroud

system.description: By focusing on the transformation of living blood to dead blood to Cainite vitae, you can partake of certain benefits of being dead. You must drink five Blood Traits from a body dead for at least one day but less than three, then expend all five to activate this power. While in effect, you gain one additional health level of armor with no Negative Traits, you can see and converse with ghosts in the area, and you can use the Valeren power Sense Life. You are two Traits down in all challenges against ghosts while using it. This power lasts one scene.
